ja: テサロニケ人への手紙第一 1

p.src: 1  Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ja: パウロ、シルワノ、テモテから、
イエス・キリストにあるテサロニケの
へ。 私たちの父なる神と主イエス・キリストから、
和があなたがたにありますように。
en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 1  Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ja: 1:1 「キリスト」は「油を注がれた者」という意味である。

zh: 帖撒羅尼迦信徒的信心和榜樣

p.src: 2  We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

ja: りのたびにあなたがたのことを
え、いつも皆のために神に感謝しています。
en: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
u.src: 2  We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

p.src: 3  remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

ja: イエス・キリストへの希望に支えられた
えず心に留めています。
en: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
u.src: 3  remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

p.src: 4  We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

ja: 姉妹、 あなたがたが
ばれていることを、私たちは
en: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
u.src: 4  We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

ja: 1:4 ここおよび文脈上可能な箇所で用いられている「兄弟」に当たる語は、「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだい」と訳すこともできる。
en: 1:4 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 5  and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

ja: きました。あなたがたのために、私たちがあなたがたの
でどのような者として過ごしたかは、あなたがた
en: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
u.src: 5  and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

p.src: 6  You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

ja: びをもってみことばを
en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
u.src: 6  You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

p.src: 7  so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

ja: こうして、マケドニアとアカイアにいるすべての
en: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
u.src: 7  so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

p.src: 8  For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

ja: のみことばは、あなたがたのもとから響き渡りました。マケドニアとアカイアだけでなく、あらゆる所に
に対するあなたがたの
が伝わっているので、私たちは
en: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.
u.src: 8  For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

p.src: 9  For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

ja: が、あなたがたがどのように私たちを迎えたか、また、どのように
えるようになったかを
en: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
u.src: 9  For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

p.src: 10  and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

ja: が天から来られるのを、あなたがたが待ち望んでいることも語っています。その御子こそ、
してくださるイエスです。
en: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
u.src: 10  and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
